findings.title: POST /api/waterings returns 500 for non-finite litres (1e309 / NaN)
findings.evidence: curl: {"bed_id":1,"litres":1e309} -> 500; NaN -> 500 (Pydantic error containing inf/nan cannot be serialised)

findings.title: Oversized integer bed_id crashes waterings endpoints with 500
findings.steps: POST {"bed_id":99999999999999999999}; GET /api/waterings?bed_id=99999999999999999999 (also reachable via /waterings?bed=99999999999999999999 in the web app); DELETE /api/waterings/999999999999999999999
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (SQLite integer overflow); the web page then shows a generic/unreachable error
findings.evidence: All three requests returned 'Internal Server Error 500'. No upper bound on bed_id/limit path/query ints.

findings.title: Tiny litres amounts are stored but displayed as '0 L'
findings.steps: Record a watering with litres 0.001 (server accepts any value > 0; the number input only hints step 0.1), then open /waterings
findings.expected: Amount is refused (below 0.1) or shown accurately
findings.evidence: SSR HTML of /waterings: '1 Jan 1 North bed 0 L' for litres 0.001 (formatLitres uses maximumFractionDigits 2)

findings.title: Absurd past dates accepted (year 0001) and shown as '1 Jan 1'
findings.where: POST /api/waterings, Beds past-watering form, Waterings page
findings.expected: Date refused with a reason (no lower bound) or a sensible range enforced
findings.evidence: API returned 201; /waterings rendered '1 Jan 1 North bed'

findings.title: Invalid ?bed= in URL shows a raw technical validation message
findings.expected: Filter ignored or a friendly message with a way to recover
findings.actual: Page shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'; select shows no matching option

findings.title: No retry on error states for the new watering lists
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings fail (server down/500) and open /waterings or the dashboard
findings.expected: Error message with a Try again button that refetches without reload
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage; no retry control (dashboard does not even destructure refresh for waterings). User must reload the page
findings.evidence: waterings.vue and index.vue: AlertMessage without any retry button

findings.title: Beds list failure on waterings page silently shows only 'All beds'
findings.actual: bedsResult.error is ignored; the select just has 'All beds' with no explanation
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: const { data: beds } = bedsResult; no error handling

findings.title: No request timeout on watering requests; buttons can stay 'Watering…'/'Saving…' indefinitely
findings.where: Beds page Water now / Save watering, Waterings delete, list fetches
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept connection, never respond) and click Water now
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s with a visible error, button re-enabled
findings.actual: useApiClient / useApiFetch set no timeout; button stays disabled and spinning until the browser gives up

findings.title: Retrying 'Water now' after a timeout/lost response records a duplicate watering
findings.steps: Click Water now; the POST commits but the response is lost/times out; click Water now again
findings.actual: Two waterings created; no idempotency key or dedupe
findings.evidence: create_watering inserts unconditionally; client sends no request id

findings.title: Watering two beds concurrently re-enables the first bed's buttons early (double submit possible)
findings.steps: Click Water now on bed A, then quickly on bed B before A finishes
findings.expected: Each bed's button stays disabled until its own request completes
findings.actual: Single wateringBedId ref is overwritten by B; A's button re-enables immediately and A can be watered twice; when A finishes, finally sets wateringBedId=null re-enabling B while still pending. Errors/notices are also single slots so one bed's error is replaced by another's
findings.evidence: beds.vue recordWatering: wateringBedId.value = bed.id ... finally wateringBedId.value = null

findings.title: Deleting a watering twice (retry after timeout) shows 'Watering not found.' error
findings.steps: Delete a watering; response lost; retry the delete
findings.expected: Treated as already deleted (no error), list refreshed
findings.actual: DELETE returns 404 and the page shows an error even though the watering is gone
findings.evidence: delete_watering raises not_found when row missing; page shows listError

findings.title: Past-watering date of 'today' can be rejected as future when browser and server time zones differ
findings.steps: Browser in a time zone ahead of the server (e.g., UTC+10 vs CET) after local midnight; keep default date (todayIso) and save
findings.actual: Server's date.today() is still yesterday so it returns 'Watering date cannot be in the future.'
findings.evidence: schemas.WateringIn.not_in_future uses server-local date.today(); form defaults/max from browser todayIso()

findings.title: Past watering form and waterings table may overflow at 375 px
findings.steps: View at 375 px width; open Record past watering; or have a 60-char unbroken bed name in the waterings table
findings.actual: .water-form uses a fixed 3-column grid (1fr 1fr auto with two buttons) with no mobile media query; the 4-column table has no wrapping/overflow handling for long names
